ayahOccurrences.text: وَإِن يَكُن لَّهُمُ ٱلْحَقُّ يَأْتُوٓا۟ إِلَيْهِ مُذْعِنِينَ
ayahOccurrences.highlightedHtml: وَإِن يَكُن لَّهُمُ ٱلْحَقُّ يَأْتُوٓا۟ إِلَيْهِ مُذْعِنِينَ

lexSnapshot.wordGrammar: accusative masculine plural (form IV) active participle
lexSnapshot.derivativeNote: مُذْعِنِينَ is in the derivative form: مُذْعِنُون
lexSnapshot.rootDefinitionHtml:
ذ/ع/ن   dh–ʿ–n to submit, to give in; to hurry up; to confess. Of this root, only مُذْعِنُون mudhʿinūn, occurs 1 time in the Qur’an
.
lexSnapshot.mainDefinitionHtml:
مُذْعِنُون mudhʿinūn [pl. of act. part. مُذْعِنٌ mudhʿin] one who submits, one who yields

(24:49) وَإِنْ يَكُنْ لَهُمُ الْحَقُّ يَأْتُوا إِلَيْهِ مُذْعِنِينَ but if they have a just claim, they come to him in submission.
